description: The bar chart, Figure 6(a), illustrates the distribution of datasets over time for the five most frequent researcher locations and all other locations combined. The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, and is labeled "Year." The vertical axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and has a logarithmic scale, spanning from 10^0 to 10^2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a year and containing six bars corresponding to different researcher locations, colored according to a legend: Other (peach), USA (white), IN (blue), UK (orange), IT (green), and DE (brown). The bars within each group are arranged side by side, with the height of each bar indicating the number of datasets for the respective location and year. The height of the bars varies across years and locations, with the USA consistently having one of the tallest bars, indicating a high number of datasets, while other locations have varying heights, with some years having very short bars, indicating few or no datasets. The bars are not sorted in a specific order within each group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
